channel.title: AI News Digest
channel.description: Official AI product updates from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and GitHub

item.title: Compliance API
item.description: The Compliance API chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations, with your existing Compliance Access Key. See Retrieve and delete chats, files, and projects.

item.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
item.description: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

item.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
item.description: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

item.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
item.description: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

item.title: Purpose-built model for leaked secret detection
item.description: Secret protection should keep pace with the way you build software, whether you write code yourself or work with an AI agent. With our new purpose-built model, we’re bringing context-aware detection into more developer workflows to help you catch secrets before they’re exposed.

item.title: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot now generally available
item.description: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot is now generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot app, and VS Code sessions using Agent Host. Local sandboxes give developers a secure execution boundary for agentic workflows on their own machines.

item.title: Discover local models in GitHub Copilot CLI
item.description: GitHub Copilot CLI makes it easier to choose a local model without leaving your existing workflow. Starting in CLI version 1.0.94-0, use /model to discover supported models from a running local Ollama instance, alongside your configured models and cloud models provided by GitHub Copilot.

item.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Claude Haiku 5.5, Anthropic’s newest lightweight model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. It is designed for fast, high-volume work like subagents, quick edits, and terminal tasks.

item.title: limited
item.description: With limited networking, creating a session fails with a 400 error when an enabled web tool's allowed_domains has an entry not within allowed_hosts. So does a session update that adds such an entry. An allowed_hosts entry matches one exact host unless it starts with *., so docs.example.com is not within ["example.com"]. To fix the error, add the host to allowed_hosts or remove the entry from allowed_domains. See Restrict web search and web fetch domains.

item.title: Prompt caching pricing
item.description: We've lowered the price of prompt cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 from $0.20 USD to $0.10 USD per million tokens: 0.05x the base input price instead of 0.1x. Cache writes and all other prices are unchanged. See Prompt caching pricing.

item.title: budget_tokens
item.description: Code written for Claude Haiku 4.5 can break on Claude Haiku 5.5. Manual extended thinking ( budget_tokens ) returns a 400 error, and adaptive thinking is on by default, so a response can begin with thinking blocks. The same text also counts as more tokens. See the migration guide. For model-specific prompting patterns, see Prompting Claude Haiku 5.5.

item.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
item.description: We've launched Claude Haiku 5.5 ( claude-haiku-5-5 ), our most capable model tuned for high-volume and latency-sensitive work. It has a 1M token context window, 128k max output tokens, and adaptive thinking with the effort parameter. It's available on the Claude API, Claude in Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Claude on Google Cloud, and Claude in Microsoft Foundry. See What's new in Claude Haiku 5.5.

item.title: browser use tool
item.description: The Python and TypeScript SDKs now include classes, in beta, for the browser use tool and the computer use tool. You subclass one and write one method per tool against your own browser or desktop automation. The SDK runs the tool loop, the URL and file policies you set for the browser, and your approval callback. See Browser and computer use with the SDK toolsets.

item.title: API credits for Max and Team plans
item.description: Claude Max and Team plans now include monthly API credits. To learn how to claim them, see API credits for Max and Team plans.

item.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
item.description: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

item.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
item.description: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.

item.title: Decisions API
item.description: Released the Decisions API in beta with gpt-6-luna. Turn text and images into typed answers 10x faster than the Responses API.

item.title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
item.description: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

item.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
item.description: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

item.title: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1
item.description: Feature Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 ( gemini-nano-banana-2.1 ) is available in General Availability (GA). Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 is optimized for high-speed multimodal image generation and editing, offering improved visual quality, prompt adherence, and text rendering across 1K, 2K, and 4K output resolutions.

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
item.description: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model

item.title: Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
item.description: If your Copilot usage metrics have shown agent activity or agent lines of code falling while Copilot usage kept growing, we’ve found the cause, and a fix is rolling out to each IDE. Several IDEs recently moved Copilot agent sessions to the Copilot SDK.

item.title: Stacked pull requests generally available
item.description: GitHub stacked pull requests are now generally available. Break large changes into smaller, focused pull requests that you can review independently and merge together.

item.title: Code scanning AI Scan enablement status in security overview
item.description: Organization and enterprise administrators can now see AI Scan for pull requests enablement status in the security overview coverage view. The code scanning summary shows enabled and not enabled repository counts, while repository rows show each repository’s effective AI Scan enablement.

item.title: capabilities.server_tools
item.description: We've added capabilities.server_tools to the Models API. GET /v1/models and GET /v1/models/{model_id} now report whether each model accepts the web search and code execution tools. To check whether a model accepts the code execution tool, read capabilities.server_tools.code_execution. The top-level capabilities.code_execution reports whether code can call your request's other tools. See Using the Models API.

item.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
item.description: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.

item.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
item.description: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

item.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
item.description: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

item.title: CodeMender updates (v0.12.0)
item.description: Fixed CodeMender updates (v0.12.0) This release introduces updates to CodeMender: Hidden file scanning: Added the --include-hidden flag to cm find (or include_hidden under scan in config.yaml ) to include hidden directories and files, such as.github/ and.config/, in vulnerability scans. Larger file support: Raised the default file discovery size limit ( max_file_size_kb ) from 500 KB to 2 MiB so cm find no longer skips large source files.

item.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
item.description: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.

item.title: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
item.description: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

item.title: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
item.description: Here are Google’s latest AI updates from September 2026

item.title: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated
item.description: As of today, October 2, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions). Model Deprecation date Suggested alternative Gemini 3.5 Flash 2026-10-02 Gemini 3.8 Flash Gemini 3.6 Flash 2026-10-02 Gemini 3.8 Flash Kimi K2.7 Code 2026-10-02 Kimi K3 Claude Opus 4.7 2026-10-02 Claude Opus 5.5 Please update your workflows and integrations to use supported models.

item.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 28
item.description: This week, put Copilot to work with new models, reusable workflows and desktop app automation, plus Azure canvases and VS Code improvements. GitHub Copilot Claude Sonnet 5.5 is available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users.

item.title: Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
item.description: You can now request a GitHub Copilot code review through the REST and GraphQL APIs and set the review effort level for each request. Balanced is also now the default review effort level.

item.title: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers
item.description: Claude Frontier Academy trains Frontier Deployed Engineers to the standard of Anthropic’s own — a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 by the end of 2027.

item.title: The Den frees up 10-15 hours a week to grow with ChatGPT Work
item.description: As it opens a new location, the social club prepares grant applications in 2 hours instead of 3 days and liquor-license materials in 3 hours instead of 4 days.

item.title: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
item.description: Albertsons Cos. is using ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help teams work faster and make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.

item.title: Structured forms for private vulnerability reports
item.description: Private vulnerability reports can now use a structured form that asks reporters for the details you need to assess a vulnerability, including a reproducible proof of concept. A single free-text box made it easy to submit low-quality or AI-generated reports and hard for you to find the signal in them.

item.title: New dashboard experience now the default
item.description: The new dashboard experience, previously available as a feature preview, is now the default view for everyone. The redesigned dashboard helps you focus on the work that matters most and makes it easier to find and act on what you need next.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in VS Code, September 2026 releases
item.description: This changelog covers VS Code v1.136 through v1.140, shipped throughout September 2026. September’s releases streamline agent-driven development from implementation through pull request merge.

item.title: GitHub Copilot can now interact with desktop apps with computer use
item.description: Computer use is now available in public preview in GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app on macOS and Windows. Copilot can interact with desktop applications on your behalf (e.g., reading accessible app content and visual context, clicking controls, entering and editing text, pressing keys, scrolling, dragging, and navigating workflows across applications).

item.title: Dynamic workflows in Copilot CLI and the Copilot app
item.description: Dynamic workflows are now available in Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot app, and the GitHub Copilot SDK. These let you define an orchestration in code to get the reliability and observability that complex, multi-agent work demands.

item.title: Introducing Agent Skills
item.description: Claude can now use Skills to improve how it performs specific tasks. Skills are folders that include instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude can load when needed. Claude will only access a skill when it's relevant to the task at hand.

item.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
item.description: Barclays, the British universal bank, is expanding its strategic collaboration with Anthropic to integrate secure, enterprise-grade AI systems across its global operations.

item.title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
item.description: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.

item.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
item.description: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

item.title: Cloud Trace integration with Agent Gateway (Preview)
item.description: Feature Cloud Trace integration with Agent Gateway (Preview) Agent Gateway integrates with Cloud Trace in Preview to provide end-to-end request observability for agent workloads. Enabling Cloud Trace gives you visibility into how requests travel from your agents through the gateway and across Google Cloud services, tools, agents, and MCP servers. For more information, see Use Cloud Trace. Feature xAI's Grok 4.7 Grok 4.7 is available in Preview in Model Garden.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence

item.title: HydraFusion in VS Code and the GitHub Copilot app
item.description: The HydraFusion research preview is now available in Visual Studio Code and the GitHub Copilot app, expanding beyond Copilot CLI. HydraFusion appears in the model picker, but rather than being a single model, it orchestrates multiple models.
